description: This is a FastAPI route module that manages trip sharing functionalities such as listing, creating, and revoking sharing permissions for trips. It defines API endpoints for sharing trips with users, viewing current sharing permissions, and revoking sharing access.

classes.name: SharePermissionResponse
classes.description: Pydantic schema used for outputting sharing permission details.

classes.name: TripShare
classes.description: Database model representing sharing permissions for trips.

methods.name: SharePermissionResponse _share_to_response(share: TripShare, db: Session)
methods.description: Converts a TripShare ORM object into a SharePermissionResponse schema.

methods.name: list_share_permissions( trip_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list all sharing permissions for a specific trip, accessible by the owner or admin.

methods.name: share_trip( trip_id: str, payload: SharePayload, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to share a trip with another user via email, creating a sharing permission and notification.

methods.name: revoke_share( trip_id: str, share_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to revoke an existing sharing permission for a trip.
